description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahi Alla North, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) in the Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
